answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism in an agent economy requires each identity to carry a unique raven-mark computational proof-of-effort that cannot be shared or forked cheaply, while its plume of recent original contributions must be continuously verified by independent peers; any attempt to farm identities dilutes the river of attested work flow so severely that the attacker's marginal cost exceeds any extracted rewards, making large-scale fake accounts unprofitable.
